THE BRIEF'S WATER REFERENCE

The three numbers
that matter.

1–3 ppm

Free chlorine

Sanitiser demand changes with conditions and pool type.

7.4–7.6

pH

pH affects water balance and sanitiser performance.

80–120 ppm

Total alkalinity

Alkalinity helps buffer changes in pH.
